accounts_normal_balance_check.name: accounts_normal_balance_check
accounts_normal_balance_check.value: "core"."accounts"."normal_balance" = case when "core"."accounts"."type" in ('asset', 'expense') then 'debit' else 'credit' end

accounts_purpose_check.name: accounts_purpose_check
accounts_purpose_check.value:
split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 2) = "core"."accounts"."purpose" and split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 1) || ':' || "core"."accounts"."type" = case "core"."accounts"."purpose"
        when 'provider_clearing' then '1000:asset'
        when 'provider_float' then '1010:asset'
        when 'bank' then '1100:asset'
        when 'settlement_in_transit' then '1200:asset'
        when 'fx_clearing' then '1900:asset'
        when 'merchant_payable' then '2000:liability'
        when 'merchant_reserve' then '2010:liability'
        when 'refund_payable' then '2100:liability'
        when 'tax_payable' then '2200:liability'
        when 'fee_revenue' then '4000:revenue'
        when 'fx_revenue' then '4100:revenue'
        when 'provider_fee_expense' then '5000:expense'
        when 'loss_writeoff' then '5100:expense'
        when 'suspense' then '9000:asset'
      end

accounts_scope_check.name: accounts_scope_check
accounts_scope_check.value:
case
        when "core"."accounts"."purpose" in ('merchant_payable', 'merchant_reserve')
          then "core"."accounts"."merchant_id" is not null and "core"."accounts"."provider" is null and split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 3) ~ '^mch_[0-9A-HJKMNP-TV-Z]{26}$'
        when "core"."accounts"."purpose" in ('provider_clearing', 'provider_float')
          then "core"."accounts"."merchant_id" is null and "core"."accounts"."provider" is not null and split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 3) = "core"."accounts"."provider"
        when "core"."accounts"."purpose" = 'bank'
          then "core"."accounts"."merchant_id" is null and "core"."accounts"."provider" is null and split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 3) ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{2,40}$'
        else "core"."accounts"."merchant_id" is null and "core"."accounts"."provider" is null and split_part("core"."accounts"."code", ':', 3) = ''
      end

transaction_events_status_check.name: transaction_events_status_check
transaction_events_status_check.value: ("core"."transaction_events"."from_status" is null or "core"."transaction_events"."from_status" in ('created', 'requires_action', 'processing', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired')) and "core"."transaction_events"."to_status" in ('created', 'requires_action', 'processing', 'succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled', 'expired')

transactions_failure_check.name: transactions_failure_check
transactions_failure_check.value:
("core"."transactions"."failure_code" is null or ("core"."transactions"."failure_code" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,63}$' and "core"."transactions"."status" in ('failed', 'cancelled', 'expired')))
        and ("core"."transactions"."failure_reason" is null or "core"."transactions"."failure_code" is not null)

checkout_sessions_complete_check.name: checkout_sessions_complete_check
checkout_sessions_complete_check.value:
("core"."checkout_sessions"."status" = 'complete') = ("core"."checkout_sessions"."completed_at" is not null)
        and ("core"."checkout_sessions"."status" <> 'complete' or "core"."checkout_sessions"."payment_id" is not null)

idempotency_keys_completed_check.name: idempotency_keys_completed_check
idempotency_keys_completed_check.value: "core"."idempotency_keys"."status" <> 'completed' or ("core"."idempotency_keys"."response_status" is not null and "core"."idempotency_keys"."response_body" is not null)

holds_end_state_check.name: holds_end_state_check
holds_end_state_check.value:
("core"."holds"."state" = 'captured') = ("core"."holds"."captured_at" is not null and "core"."holds"."capture_key" is not null)
        and ("core"."holds"."state" = 'released') = ("core"."holds"."released_at" is not null and "core"."holds"."release_key" is not null)
        and ("core"."holds"."state" = 'expired') = ("core"."holds"."expired_at" is not null)
        and ("core"."holds"."capture_key" is null or "core"."holds"."state" = 'captured')
        and ("core"."holds"."release_key" is null or "core"."holds"."state" = 'released')
